speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) what is the outcome of the investigation into the alleged bullying case in Mee Toh School; and (b) whether there will be a review of the standard operating procedures in place or specific training for school staff to respond to such bullying cases.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: In this case, the Principal made them revisit the incident, with them standing in the shoes of the victim.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: This made the wrongdoers truly regret their actions.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They had to apologise in person to the victim.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The school also engaged the parents of the wrongdoers.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They all understood the seriousness of their children's actions and supported the school's action.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The school has observed that the students have interacted well after the school-facilitated reconciliation sessions.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: MOE will further strengthen our efforts to educate our students against bullying in our schools.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: It will encourage those adversely affected by bullying to seek out help without fear of stigma.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: I am just curious though, because, based on the news report, the sister of the victim indicated that this was not the first time that the victim had been bullied.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: So, my first supplementary question is, do we know how long this has been going on?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: I am asking because, if this has been going on for some time, then, it is of concern if the teachers and the people in the school had not noticed and taken any action.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: My second question relates to the similar issue of the sister raising the matter on Twitter.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: What is the formal channel in which the parents or family members of victims can raise their concerns?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: I understand based on the report in the news, that the sister had said that she had raised it to the school, but no action had been taken.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: So, I just wanted to know what was the background to these circumstances and whether there is a need to actually review the process?

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: I do not have the specific timeline for this case in question.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: However, what I can reassure the Member is this – the schools and teachers take such allegations very seriously.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: Parents would be encouraged to speak to the teachers and the schools to highlight such cases.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: So, I think at the end of the day, the key thing is this – to bring it to the attention of the teachers in the schools as soon as possible.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: From the MOE side of the house, we want to make sure that the schools respond appropriately and quickly and in time, and also to make sure that we have the appropriate peer support culture.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: So, in this particular instance as we have said, measures were taken and the matter has been resolved.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: But, we will also continue to make sure that going forward, for this particular case as well as for other students in other schools, any allegations of bullying would be addressed appropriately and in a timely fashion.
